guarantees.claim: When any of cmd_error_o, inputs_invalid_o, or fsm_error_o is asserted (non-zero), kmac_data_o.data is forced to decoy_data, overriding all other conditions.
If no error condition is true, and valid and adv_en_i are true, kmac_data_o.data is assigned adv_data[adv_sel].
If no error condition is true, valid is true, adv_en_i is false, and id_en_i is true, kmac_data_o.data is assigned id_data[id_sel].
If no error condition is true, valid is true, both adv_en_i and id_en_i are false, and gen_en_i is true, kmac_data_o.data is assigned gen_data[gen_sel].
In the absence of any active error, valid, and enable condition, kmac_data_o.data remains as decoy_data (the default assignment).

assumptions.claim: The index signals adv_sel, id_sel, gen_sel must be within the valid index range of the corresponding arrays adv_data, id_data, gen_data.
assumptions.cond: When the respective enable (adv_en_i, id_en_i, gen_en_i) is active and valid is true
assumptions.risk: Out-of-bounds index can cause simulation X‑propagation or undefined hardware behavior.

assumptions.claim: When valid is asserted, at most one of adv_en_i, id_en_i, gen_en_i is asserted, or the fixed priority order (adv > id > gen) is acceptable to the design intent.
assumptions.risk: If multiple enables are asserted unintentionally, lower-priority sources are silently ignored, possibly causing a functional bug (e.g., missed ID or GEN data).

assumptions.claim: decoy_data must be a safe value (e.g., constant, zeroized, or random) that does not expose sensitive state when error conditions force it onto the output.
assumptions.risk: If decoy_data contains secret intermediate bits, the error path may leak sensitive information on kmac_data_o.

uncertain_points.claim: It is unclear if decoy_data is securely sourced (cleared, constant, or truly random) so that error conditions do not leak secret state via kmac_data_o.
uncertain_points.cond: When any of cmd_error_o, inputs_invalid_o, or fsm_error_o is active
uncertain_points.risk: An unsafe decoy_data could expose key material or intermediate values on the KMAC data output during error handling.

uncertain_points.claim: The select indices adv_sel, id_sel, gen_sel are used to index arrays without local range protection; upstream logic must guarantee they remain within bounds.
uncertain_points.cond: When corresponding enable and valid are true
uncertain_points.risk: An out-of-bound index could cause simulation mismatches or hardware misread, potentially corrupting data selection.
